It encountered [[Resistance]] members [[Poe Dameron]] and [[Kazuda Xiono]] in [[34 ABY]], resulting in its destruction. ==History== {{Quote|Uh, what is that? I thought there weren't any active droids here.''"
"''That one looks pretty active.|Kazuda Xiono and Poe Dameron|}} Manufactured by [[Rebaxan Columni]], the [[First Order sentry droid|sentry droid]] served the [[First Order]] aboard the [[mining]] [[space station]] [[Station Theta Black]]. In [[34 ABY]], [[Resistance]] operatives [[Poe Dameron]] and [[Kazuda Xiono]] were sent to [[Mission to Station Theta Black|investigate]] a potential First Order outpost, Station Theta Black. As the two approached the station in their [[T-70 X-wing starfighter]]s, Dameron and his [[Astromech droid|droid]] [[CB-23]] confirmed there were no active life signs or [[droid]]s aboard the mining station. [[File:FirstOrderSentryDroidExtends-StationThetaBlack.gif|200px|thumb|left|The sentry droid unfolded to attack Poe Dameron and Kazuda Xiono.]] Dameron made the decision to explore the mining station, with Xiono and [[BB-8]], their [[BB-series astromech droid|droid]] companion, joining him as CB-23 hid their [[X-wing starfighter]]s. The group explored Station Theta Black in search of a [[computer]] to access the station's records. BB-8 discovered the seemingly inactive sentry droid while Xiono found a nearby console. As BB-8 and Xiono worked together to determine the station's purpose, the sentry droid was activated by the presence of the Resistance members.{{Databank|first-order-sentry-droid|First Order Sentry Droid}} ==Characteristics== {{Listen3|FirstOrderSentryDroidBlasters-StationThetaBlack.flac|the First Order sentry droid's blasters}} As a [[Class four droid|fourth class droid]],''[[Star Wars: The Visual Encyclopedia]]'' — Based on corresponding information for [[First Order sentry droid]]s the [[security droid]] patrolled Station Theta Black. It stood at 1.5 [[meter]]s, or 4 [[Foot|feet]] and 11 inches tall, when fully extended. The droid had [[Color|white]] plating, with black and gray colored interior sections, that were exposed when the droid extended its body. ==Behind the scenes== The sentry droid first appeared "[[Station Theta Black (episode)|Station Theta Black]]," the eleventh episode of the [[Star Wars Resistance Season One|first season]] of the animated television series ''[[Star Wars Resistance]]'', which aired on [[December 9]], [[2018]].{{DisneyPress|wdtv=1|url=disneychannel/shows/star-wars-resistance/episodes|text=Star Wars Resistance}} [[JP Balmet]],{{SW|url=star-wars-resistance-secrets-and-holograms-concept-art-gallery|text=Secrets and Holograms Concept Art Gallery}} {{C|Slide 12}} senior concept designer for the episode, created concept art for the droid on [[June 6]], [[2017]]. ===Concept art gallery=== {{Gallery |source=''[[Star Wars Resistance]]'' |storyboards= |concept= File:FirstOrderSentryDroid-ConceptArt.png|droidFoSntryA, JP Balmet |digital= |in-progress= }} ==Appearances== {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of unidentified First Order sentry droid|soundcat=Audio files of unidentified First Order sentry droid}} *{{Resistance|Station Theta Black (episode)}} {{1st}} ==Sources== *{{SW|url=series/star-wars-resistance/station-theta-black-episode-guide|text="Station Theta Black" Episode Guide | Star Wars Resistance}} *{{BucketsList|CsijV7kM8no|#1.11: "Station Theta Black"|sw_url=video/buckets-list-station-theta-black-star-wars-resistance}} *{{SW|url=news/buckets-list-extra-station-theta-black-star-wars-resistance|text=Bucket's List Extra: 11 Fun Facts from "Station Theta Black" -
